notes.title: New Version Arrives
notes.notes:
[h1]New Version Update 🔥[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PaiTd24.png[/img]

Dear Strikers,

Battle Teams will enter the new version 1.46 update for American servers on [b]July 31[/b] at [b]10:00 AM Beijing Time / 11:00 PM CDT[/b] for over 4–5 hours. 🕛 During this time, servers will be closed and you cannot login to the game. If maintenance is completed sooner than expected, the game will be available to login.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Om2Ug7S.png[/img]

What to expect in the next coming version? 

[h3][b]1. Dimensional Rift – Mirage Citadel Final Stage is open[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]The Mirage Citadel arc concludes with a visually stunning and challenging finally stage for neon city packed with chaotic boss phases and cinematic intensity.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9pkOmoH.png[/img]

[h3][b]2. Main Story Chapter 3 – Rapid Extreme Mode[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Experience Chapter 3 in Rapid Mode with increased difficulty, faster combat pacing, and greatly enhanced drop rewards, giving high tier players to test how far their damage can reach. 
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mME25oc.png[/img]

[h3][b]3. Gun Spirit Dispatch Center[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Assign your Gun Spirits to passive missions that collect loot automatically, helping you stay rewarded even while offline.
[/list]

You can join the Dispatch center from the Dim Chasm or from your Battlefield lobby: 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iOlseCr.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/W0Mcgj8.png[/img]

[b]You can expend the section below for more information, Details will be posted on a discord article: [/b]

[expand=📦 Dispatch System – Full Auto Rewards Mode]
The Dispatch Agency is a system that lets you assign Gun Spirits to auto-clear Special 5 difficulty stages in the main storyline, earning rewards over time without manual play. It helps reduce repetitive grinding and lets players focus on more interesting content. Access it from the battlefield in Adventure Mode (below Recon icon) or from inside Dimensional Rift stages.

At first, you can dispatch 1 Gun Spirit to level 1 missions. As the Dispatch Station upgrades (up to Lv19), it unlocks more chapters (Maya, Desert, Hell, Islands), adds more dispatch teams (up to 3), increases team capacity, and boosts speed (up to +100%). Upgrades require Dispatch Experience, earned by collecting new Gun Spirits and relics — higher rarity gives more points, with a current total max of 12,360 XP (up to Lv17). 

Missions require prior manual Expert-clear, specific Gun Spirit stars (1★ to 5★ based on chapter), stamina, and silver. Dispatch shares a weekly 100-run cap with Expert 5, and rewards relics, and even rare qualification gems. Players are advised to follow strategies like prioritizing high-chapter missions first, using “Auto Arrange,” and clicking each level to test Gun Spirit fit. Although collecting and upgrading Gun Spirits costs gold, the returns in rare resources and time-saving make Dispatch a powerful system — especially in later chapters. Start early or risk falling behind.
[/expand]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/G5xkjnH.png[/img]


[h3][b]4. Speed Mode Chapter 2[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]A harder version of Chapter 2 is here with enhanced AI behavior and increased item drops for players who dare to enter.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7XAPoOV.png[/img]

[h3][b]5. Dimensional Chasm – Maze Treasure Hunt[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Traverse a mysterious underground labyrinth filled with traps, puzzles, and rare rewards in this limited-time maze expedition.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Tmuo5ST.png[/img]

Some information can be found by expending the tab below, more details will be shared on discord article. 
[expand=🐉 Dragon Tomb (Dimensional Rift Chapter 2) – Full Mechanics Overview]
Dragon Tomb is Chapter 2 of the Dimensional Rift, featuring 6 stages. Clearing each stage unlocks the next. You get 10 attempts per stage weekly (each costs 300 stamina), reset every Saturday. No rewards if you exceed the count or lack stamina. Gun Spirits can assist, but there are no normal/hard modes or side paths.

Each stage randomly spawns four types of treasure chests (green, blue, yellow, red). The first three are guaranteed; red is rare and hidden. Max 3 chest waves per stage. To open them, you need 100% “Energy Value”: killing mobs gives 50%, killing the boss gives the other 50%. Chests have 100 HP and will break if enemies attack them too much.

Higher “Danger Level” boosts enemy strength and rewards. Red chests and Treasure Rats have spawn probabilities shown on the mini-map. Treasure Rats are high-reward mobs that don’t attack, have low HP, and drop rare items. Up to 3 can appear per run, surviving 5 minutes max.

Each boss has unique mechanics:  
• Xing Tian disables healing and attack buffs  
• White Bone Lady self-heals  
• Demon Dragon causes stuns  
• Spider Queen heals but is weaker  
• Green Snake summons clones and needs Corrosion weapons to break shields  
• Blood Puppet has high HP and strong damage, supported by elite mobs

Recommended weapons: use Yin-Yang or Corrosion types like Oracle, Moyun, or Arc Flash for shield-breaking.  
Accessory synergy:  
• “Tiger Claw” boosts red chest & rat spawn rate  
• “Golden Umbrella” speeds up energy gain and reduces damage  
• “Mojin Charm” increases Danger Level and red chest chances  
• “Oracle” weapons improve collector HP and suppress interfering mobs

**Gameplay Strategy:**  
• Beginners: focus on green chests, ignore rats  
• Intermediate: aim for blue chests and raise Danger to trigger rats  
• Advanced: wear epic Tiger Claw and farm 3-red/3-rat farming teams

**Collectibles:** 4 series, 6 quality levels each. Just to get all Silver-quality collectibles requires ~1,042 clears (60/week → 17 weeks minimum). Grind level is as high as Expert collectibles.

Also includes the permanent “Dragon Treasure Hunt” event: 6-week duration, 10 free entries/week (60 total), with optional paid tries. Treasure Hunt simplifies gameplay: opening a chest triggers the boss instantly. Red chests drop Hunt Tokens to exchange for rare items like chips and collectibles.
[/expand]

[h3][b]6. New Competitive Mode – Peak League 1v1[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Face off in intense 1v1 elimination brackets with weapon bans, loadout picks, and strategic matchups.
[*]Top 512 players qualify for finals. Earn Peak Tokens to craft limited items like [i]Peak Dragon Wings[/i].
[*]Spectators can vote and earn rewards!
[/list]

[b]Click below for some information[/b]

[expand=🥊 Peak League Tournament – Competitive 1v1 Showdown]
The Peak League (乱斗巅峰赛) is a 1v1 single-elimination PvP tournament. Players progress through regional qualifiers toward a 512-player final bracket. Matches follow a double-elimination format and best-of-three rules.

Each round includes weapon bans and strategic loadout selections. Peak Tokens earned during the tournament can unlock exclusive cosmetic items like [b]Peak Dragon Wings[/b]. A test season ran May 10–31, and the official launch began June 7. Spectators can vote for players to gain bonus rewards.
[/expand]

[h3][b]7. Chapter 4 Desert – Extreme Rapid Mode[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Extreme Rapid Mode returns for Chapter 4, featuring faster-paced enemies and elite-tier drop rates for high-end players.
[/list]
Ready to show of your power ? 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kkReVVo.png[/img]


[h3][b]8. Adventure Event – Return to Base (Ranked)[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Battle across 3 ranked lanes (Black Iron → Gold), facing waves of enemies under a time-attack system.
[*]Earn ranking points to climb the leaderboard and unlock sharpshooter  cores, resets, slot unlockers, and more.
[/list]

[expand=🏆 Return to Base – Ranked Adventure Event Details]
Return to Base features three challenge lanes with increasing difficulty and quality (Black Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold). You fight timed waves of enemies, including a final boss—defeating it quickly boosts your score.

Rewards are based on waves cleared and lane difficulty. Players can use slot unlockers and resets (purchased with gold) to increase attempts and push higher rankings. Daily attempts refresh, and global milestones allow everyone to claim stage rewards. Top players receive exclusive items such as Gun God cores and advanced proficiency gear.
[/expand]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U4IimxN.png[/img]

[h3][b]9. Eternal Realm – Solo PvE Progression Mode[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Daily free entry into a new single-player challenge mode with rising difficulty.
[*]Progress to Stage 22+ to unlock shared resource points across servers.
[/list]

[expand=⛰️ Eternal Realm – Solo PvE Overview]
Eternal Realm is a new single-player challenge mode where you enter daily for free. After the first run, you’ll need Eternal Keys to continue, with increasing cost per stage.

Each cleared stage grants better rewards. Reaching Stage 22 unlocks cross-server resource points, which players can fight over to gain shared bonuses. The mode resets daily, with no penalty for failure—just keep climbing!
[/expand]

[h3][b]10. Road to Sharpshooter Extended[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Huge Energy Strength Boost
[*]Huge Crit Chance and Crit Damage boost
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cgRZnXI.png[/img]

[h3][b]11. Dimensional Chasm – Iron Mace Phantom [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]A twisted new Chapter 3 Research Base dungeon introduces fresh rules, enemies and boss mechanics.
[*]Difficulty and rewards scale via “scrolling stats” — no Normal/Hard/Nightmare tiers like before.
[*]Clears follow a randomized challenge system. High-end modifiers like attribute bars and Yin‑Yang shields can appear, requiring special weapon types to overcome.
[*]Unlocks 5 runs per week. Drops include holographic gems, adventure resources, and four unique collectible series (each with 6 tiers) that boost offense, defense, crit and shields.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fqdQDxK.png[/img]

[b]Click to expand for some mechanics details:[/b]

[expand=🧪 Iron Mace Phantom – Rift Chapter 3 Full Mechanics]
Iron Mace Phantom (铁城幽影) is the third chapter of Dimensional Rift. It introduces new enemies and boss mechanics. Like the “Return to Base” event, it uses a challenge progression system: higher difficulty modifiers yield better drops—no fixed difficulty levels. This includes attribute health bars and Yin‑Yang shields instead of just increased HP. Without special weapons, even low-tier modifiers can block progression .

You get **5 entry attempts per week**. Rewards include holographic gems, adventure resources, and four collectible sets (each with six quality levels). Activated collectibles grant strong stats like penetration, shield strength, crit damage, and general combat power—making Iron Mace Phantom a major farming hotspot after Dragon Tomb.
[/expand]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wyrdk7r.png[/img]

[h3][b]12. Extreme Talent – Load Value System [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Equip powerful Load Skills unlocked through weapon reconstruction.
[*]Manage your total Load Value pool strategically — each skill consumes points based on its strength.
[*]Increase your Load capacity by upgrading weapons and reaching VIP milestones.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rOg7uXx.png[/img]

[expand=⚙️ Load Value – Extreme Talent System Explained]
The Load Value (负荷值) system is the foundation for the [b]Extreme Talent[/b] feature, allowing you to equip powerful skills known as Load Skills after reconstructing (rebirthing) your weapon.

Each Load Skill requires a number of Load Points. Your total Load Value starts at 50 and increases based on various upgrades:

• Golden Weapon: +2 pts  
• Hero Weapon (1st upgrade): +1 pt  
• VIP Lv8: +12 pts  
• Hero gear and more also add bonuses

To equip Load Skills, your total selected skills must not exceed your Load Value. This forces you to make smart trade-offs between power and point cost, allowing for customized talent builds based on your gear progression.
[/expand]


[h3][b]13. New Enhancement – Divine Forge for Character Gear[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]A new gear progression system is now available for characters in Adventure Mode.
[*]Unlock Divine Forge once all 4 gear pieces reach max level in Enhance, Modify, and Advance.
[*]Greatly boosts stats and unlocks the “Stigmata” socket system.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GSpEYGb.png[/img]

[expand=⚙️ Divine Forge – Full Mechanics (100% from CN source)]
Once a character’s four gear parts reach full level in [b]Enhance (强化)[/b], [b]Modify (改造)[/b], and [b]Advance (进阶)[/b], the [b]Divine Forge (神锻)[/b] system becomes available in Adventure Mode.

• [b]Forge (锻造):[/b] Consume materials to increase equipment stats.  
• [b]Divinize (神化):[/b] Raise the stat cap by upgrading the Forge tier (may reduce current level slightly).  
Both steps enhance attributes significantly.

You can access Divine Forge from your character circle in Adventure, or via the “Workshop” in the camp lobby.

[b]Stigmata System (圣痕):[/b]  
• Each gear piece has a Stigmata socket.  
• Socketed Stigmata grant additional attributes.  
• The number and value of Stigmata attributes depend on the gear’s Divine Forge level.  
• Stigmata can be acquired using appraisal items (鉴定器) on raw Stigmata stones.

[b]Material Sources:[/b]  
• T2 Forge Stones drop from Lv.4+ chests in DLC chapter “Iron Mace Phantom”  
• T1 Forge Stone Packs can be purchased in the Discount Mall and may contain A- or B-type materials.
[/expand]

[h3][b]14. Adventure Event – Greed Altar (Preheat)[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Exclusive solo Adventure Mode event launching ahead of the 11th Anniversary.
[*]Enter through the lobby under the King’s Brawl section.
[/list]

[expand=⚠️ Greed Altar Preheat – Mechanics & Timeline]
This is a [b]solo-only[/b] Adventure Mode preheat event called [b]Greed Altar[/b], leading into the upcoming anniversary update.



[b]• Mode Type:[/b] Solo play only — no co-op allowed  
[b]• Challenge Tickets:[/b] Extra entries can be bought using altar charms from the gold shop  

[b]Difficulty Levels:[/b] Normal, Hard, Nightmare — harder modes cost more entries and give better rewards.  
[b]Rewards:[/b] Each clear grants Ritual Tokens (仪式火种), used in the exclusive event shop for valuable loot.

This preheat version previews mechanics and content coming in the full 11th Anniversary event, including tougher bosses, blood sacrifice features, and more.
[/expand]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WenCHnc.png[/img]



[h3][b]15. Divine Forge – Stigmata System [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Gear pool expanded with divine-tier enhancements and Stigmata customization.
[*]Stigmata are socketed on max‑forged equipment and provide powerful stat bonuses.
[*]Saint Stones (圣痕原石) drop from Greed Altar or event shops, then turned into Stigmata with appraisal items.
[/list]

[expand=🧬 Stigmata Mechanics – Official CN Update]
Stigmata (圣痕) unlock after using the [b]Divine Forge (装备神锻)[/b] system:

• Once an item’s Enhance, Modify, and Advance levels are maxed, the Forge system is unlocked
• In the Forge menu, each gear has a Stigmata socket. Click below the gear to open the Stigmata page. 
• Socketed Stigmata grant attribute bonuses. Their number and strength depend on your gear’s forge level.
• Stigmata are created from appraisal of Saint Stones (圣痕原石·Ⅰ/Ⅱ), which drop from [b]Greed Altar[/b] or event shops.
• Stone types match equipment slots (e.g. Armor, Gloves, Detector, Field), and artifact-only Stigmata can only be socketed into their respective slot.
• Saint Stones yield Stigmata with 1–2 or 1–3 random stats (depending on rank I or II). 
• Some stats have set bonuses—e.g. “Solo,” “Twin,” “Trinity,” “Quad,” or conditional triggers like energy threshold, weapon collection count, or activated collectible count. 
[/expand]


[h3][b]16. Armed Assault – New Stage: Omnic Crisis [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]A brand-new large-scale raid boss: [b]AI Girl (AI少女)[/b] enters the battlefield.
[*]Up to 10 players can team up to challenge this high-intensity boss.
[*]Expect massive AoE attacks, healing abilities, and instant-kill mechanics—survival depends on team coordination.
[*]Greatly increased emblem drop rate for redeeming shop resources.
[/list]

[expand=🤖 Omnic Crisis – Full Raid Overview]
Omnic Crisis (智械危机) is the latest Armed Raid stage featuring a brand-new boss: [b]AI Girl[/b]. This large-scale PvE fight allows up to 10 players to cooperate in real-time.

The boss features:
• Massive AoE skills  
• Self-healing mechanics  
• Instant-kill (秒杀) attacks  
• High durability and pressure

Only coordinated players will survive. This mode also offers [b]more currency[/b] than previous raids—perfect for shop exchange and progression.

This is currently the hardest challenge in Armed Raid and is ideal for maxed-out loadouts.
[/expand]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1oY6J9d.png[/img]


[h3][b]17. Armed Assault– New Global Difficulty: Expert Mode[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]A new “Expert” difficulty level has been added to Armed Raid mode.
[*]Clearing it grants increased emblem drops and higher-tier item rewards.
[*]Designed for experienced players looking for maximum challenge and payoff.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LSoGuRR.png[/img]

[h3][b]18. Chapter 5 – Rapid Difficulty[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Rapid Mode is now available for Chapter 5: Hell City.
[*]Players jump straight into the boss battle—no more wave clearing.
[*]Supports up to 12 players in co-op mode.
[/list]

[expand=🔥 Hell City – Extreme Raid Mechanics]
In this updated [b]Extreme Difficulty[/b] version of Chapter 5, players bypass trash mobs and enter directly into the boss fight. This makes for a faster, more focused encounter ideal for high-level farming.

[b]Why it matters:[/b]  
• Boss mechanics are harder, with less margin for error  
• Requires optimized loadouts and team coordination  
• Shorter runs = faster loot cycles

Perfect for experienced squads looking to grind rare drops efficiently in Hell City.
[/expand]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HdbRghx.png[/img]


[h3][b]19. 11th Anniversary Event – Official Greed Altar [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Main seasonal event for the 11th Anniversary, running from [b]Sep 27 – Nov 21[/b].
[*]Solo Adventure challenge with risk-reward dungeon runs and expanding difficulty.
[*]Collect Ritual Tokens to unlock exclusive shop items, stigmata stones, and more.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JQSMqt4.jpeg[/img]

[expand=🔥 Greed Altar – Full Event Features]
The [b]Greed Altar[/b] is the core event for the 11th Anniversary. Compared to the preheat, this full version adds:

• More rewards  
• Expanded mechanics  
• New battle effects, elite enemies, and powerful negative buffs  

[b]Key Details:[/b]  
• Get 25 entries at launch + 10 weekly on Saturdays  
• Single-player only — tickets (祭坛符咒) required for extra entries  
• Difficulty: Normal (1 ticket), Hard (5), Nightmare (25)  
• Earn Ritual Tokens (仪式火种) to exchange in the event shop

[b]Gameplay Highlights:[/b]  
• Choose from randomized negative effects after each stage  
• Lock loot to protect it in case of failure (within weight limit)  
• Defeat elite enemies with deadly traits: explosions, shadow debuffs, chain auras  
• Tasks: Eliminate, Collect, Control Zones, Defend Treasures  
• Permanent “Shadow of Death” debuff builds up during run — maxing it kills you instantly  

[b]Rewards:[/b]  
• Huge shop with materials, tokens, and [b]Stigmata Stones I & II[/b]  
• Progression carries into future Divine Forge upgrades  
• Multiple layers of risk-vs-reward every time you continue

This is the most advanced and brutal solo event ever added. Perfect for experienced players and collectors.
[/expand]

[h3][b]20. Divine & Chaotic Chips – VR Dragoon System[/b][/h3]
[i]Master these SSS-tier chips to enhance survivability, burst potential, and PvE dominance.[/i]

[quote]
🎯 These chips are divided into two families: [b]Chaotic[/b]  and [b]Divine[/b]. Each chip belongs to a role—[b]Support[/b], [b]Attack[/b], or [b]Defense[/b]—and synergizes within its type.
[/quote]


[h3][b]⚔️ Chaotic Chip Set[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BgkinjX.png[/img]


[list]
[*][b]Chaotic Blast[/b] (Support/Active) – Charges up then unleashes a powerful AoE field, greatly increasing energy strength and dealing heavy damage over time. Restores Chaotic Power with each enemy hit.
[*][b]Chaotic Origin[/b] (Support/Passive) – Generates 70% Chaotic Power at key phases (death/revival/start), then converts energy into damage when it changes.
[*][b]Chaotic Mark[/b] (Attack/Passive) – Marks enemies on hit. Marked targets take bonus Dragoon damage and recover Chaotic Power when hit again.
[*][b]Chaotic Block[/b] (Defense/Passive) – Grants massive damage reduction and Chaotic Power when hit from long range. Trigger chance scales by distance.
[/list]

[h3][b]🛡️ Divine Chip Set[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ADHIa2o.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Divine Blast[/b] (Support/Active) – Boosts energy regen and penetration. Each energy used restores HP, energy, and slightly extends duration.
[*][b]Holy Source[/b] (Support/Passive) – Continuously generates Holy Sacred Power over time and from kills. Essential for energy sustain.
[*][b]Holy Heart[/b] (Attack/Passive) – For every 300 points of Holy Power stacked by 1 stack, the player gains the following effect: 10% damage bonus, 20% movement speed bonus
[*][b]Holy Reincarnation[/b] (Defense/Passive) – When HP drops below 50%, consumes power to block the hit and grants 3 seconds of invincibility.
[/list]

[h3][b]🎒 Chip Bags & Ranks[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7FixpaD.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f7QV64q.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Chaotic Chip Bag[/b] – Grants random Chaotic chip; General and Elite versions can yield up to [b]S-rank[/b], while Supreme bags can yield [b]SSS-rank (Red)[/b].
[*][b]Divine Chip Bag[/b] – Same system applies; used to obtain random Divine chips with ranking tied to bag type.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GFinSBm.png[/img]


[quote]
💡 [i]Pro Tip:[/i] Build synergy: Combine Support + Attack or Defense chips from the same family. Chaotic excels at burst and debuffing; Divine focuses on healing, resistance, and survival.
[/quote]
[hr][/hr]

Chaotic Chip at Max Level can deal massive damage allowing you to clear 2-3 floors in Arena using Dragoon Only. 

At Max level using Deer Level 20 dragoon, the damage is : 32k x100m x 16 seconds
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TvpLba0.png[/img]

[h3][b]21. Level 2000 Unlocked[/b][/h3]
[i]Push your limits with the new max level cap![/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/raDNdp7.png[/img]

[list]
[*]The player level cap has been officially raised to [b]Lv.2000[/b].
[*]Perfect for veterans seeking long-term progression and show off. 
[/list]

[h3][b]22. Fuel Attribute System – Passive Boss Resistance[/b][/h3]
[i]Weapons now contribute hidden Fuel Attributes that passively reduce boss buffs in PvE fights.[/i]

[quote]
📌 Each weapon has Fuel Attributes that accumulate in your account’s attribute pool.

[b]These resistance points reduce boss BUFF effects during combat:[/b]
[list]
[*][color=red][b]Hardened Skin[/b][/color] – Reduces damage taken. Unreduced layers = higher incoming damage.
[*][color=purple][b]Kinetic Reduction[/b][/color] – Reduces boss Crit Rate. Unreduced layers = higher chance to be crit.
[*][color=blue][b]Impact[/b][/color] – Reduces boss Crit DMG. Unreduced layers = higher crit multiplier.
[*][color=green][b]HP Contamination[/b][/color] – Increases your shield regen. Unreduced layers = reduced recovery.
[*][color=orange][b]Strength Enhance[/b][/color] – Reduces boss ATK buff. Unreduced layers = higher boss DMG output.
[*][color=darkred][b]Life Absorption[/b][/color] – Prevents boss from dealing lifesteal-type damage.
[/list]
[/quote]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Jlvy9M3.png[/img]

[b]🔸 How it works:[/b]
[list]
[*]Each weapon adds 1–2 points to specific attributes shown in the fuel icon tab.
[*]Total points stack across your loadout and contribute globally.
[*]More resistance layers = less risk from boss-enhanced mechanics.
[/list]

[h3][b]22. Year of Snake Event – Suishé Night Dungeon[/b][/h3]
[i]Strategic slot-slot dungeon with high reward ceilings and complex boss mechanics.[/i]

[list]
[*]New T-boss boss fight with layered mechanics combining poison, split attacks, and AoE traps.
[*]Three difficulty tiers: Normal (4M HP), Hard (400M), Nightmare (40B), plus special slot modifiers.
[*]Use “slot activator/resets” to stake bonus health & buffs, increasing risk & reward.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/t6nxswC.png[/img]

[expand=🔮 Suishé Night – Event Overview]
Runs from [Date] to [Date]. Each week gives 10 free entry tickets; extra slots can be purchased.  
Expect rich rewards like event currency, exclusive cores, skins, and chip supreme packs.
[/expand]


[h2]23. Four New Legendaries Arrives! 👑 [/h2]

[i]Each weapon grants a unique attribute that accumulates in your account background, giving you passive boosts.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/92kXbn7.png[/img]

[h3][b]1. Oracle • Finale - Legendary Shotgun [/b][/h3]
[quote]
[Legend Weapon] When the managerial officers of SunStrike Org. carried out special missions, they were dragged into a Chrono collision by accident caused by the force, falling into a Fissure plain. They discovered that the collided Chrono still has a Chrono connection. After the accident, the SunStrike Org. Cross League made use of the wasted Fixed Starcore to develop an Ultimate Weapon that none can copy, giving the wielder the power of going through different Fissures. The managerial officers of the Cross League named it – the Oracle.
[/quote]

[b][u]It is the best weapon of the whole 2025 version, all you have to do is shoot unlike starshatter, and enjoy massive damage.[/u][/b]

[h3][b]2. Dragon Breath • Finale - Legendary Tactical [/b][/h3]
[quote]
[Legend Weapon] Drain the power of the great dragon, dense the essence of the world into the one.

[quote]
[Legend Weapon] With the mysterious technology upgrade based on the RPK God, in addition to the free 30k Gold to the previous owner of the basic version.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tXOG6AF.png[/img]

[quote]
Enchantment Factory Details

Skin Enchantment Rules:
1. Use Pure Iron to upgrade the Enchantment Level of the weapon’s Skin.
2. Can get Adventure Attributes or Skin Effects upon reaching different levels.
3. If you don’t own the enchantment Skin, then you can’t enchant anything.
4. The Enchantment Skin List will refresh from time to time.
5. You have to select the effect when your enchanted Skin acquires new effects in order to equip it into the Battle.
6. Enchanted Skin: It has to be equipped to your Weapon in your current Backpack in order to activate the Attributes.
7. For skins with multiple levels of effects, when you select the effect of the higher level, it will contain lower level effects.
[/quote]
